# Vaillant sensoNET VR 921 (scan: MF=Vaillant;ID=NETX3) at address f6.
# The NETX is the internet module for the myVaillant cloud. On the bus it's a
# very active MASTER -- it constantly polls the other devices (in ebusd's log
# the many QQ=f1 lines) -- but practically gives out nothing itself. Measured
# on the real device (SW=0126
#   hex f6b503020001   -> 0a ff*10   error log
#   hex f6b5040100     -> 00         acknowledged
#   hex f6b509030d1800 -> 00         acknowledged
#   hex f6b5110101     -> 00         acknowledged
# This file exists not for the data
column3: but so the scan runs cleanly:

column1: # without it ebusd permanently reports
#   [main error] unable to load scan config f6: no file from vaillant with prefix f6 found
# No poll priority: ebusd only rotates through messages with r<n>
# permanently empty error log doesn't belong there.
# Cf. john30/ebusd-configuration#515 -- there an f6 file was rejected for lack
# of queryable values. That's justified based on the measurements above; this
# file explicitly doesn't claim to do more than that.
# The integration shows SW/HW automatically from the scan data anyway (device
# firmware/hardware) -- BUT only once the device is actually created
# only happens once there is AT LEAST ONE entity with a value. The empty error
# log (only "-") is NOT enough for that. 0704 as its own CSV message doesn't
# work (ebusd reserves it for scanning -> it's silently discarded).
*r
r
